llm_request:
Please write a professional email to Ms. Amanda regarding a medical device import and certification matter. The email should cover the following points:

1. We have identified a way to overcome CE certificate requirements and other needed standards.

2. Due to the danger class of this device, our Ministry of Health (MOH) has become much more restrictive about imports from G4 countries (China, India, Southeast Asia, etc.).

3. If obtaining standards and certificates takes too much time, we propose OEM as an alternative, or preferably pursuing CKD (Completely Knocked Down) or SKD (Semi-Knocked Down) options.

4. We can commit to ordering more than 200 devices over 1.5 years.

5. We have successfully completed CKD orders with major brands like VIMS (France) and Hermann (Germany).

6. CKD or SKD production in our country benefits from special facilities, government support for domestic production, and job creation initiatives, which allows us to resolve standards and licensing obstacles much faster.

7. If the trial version and field test of the Insufflator meets our needs, we will order a significantly higher quantity.

Please write this as a formal, professional business email with appropriate greeting and closing.
llm_response:
Subject: Update on Import Strategy and Certification for [Device Name/Insufflator]

Dear Ms. Amanda,

I hope this email finds you well. 

I am writing to provide an update regarding the import and certification process for the Insufflator. After thorough research, we are pleased to inform you that we have successfully identified a viable workaround to overcome the current CE certificate requirements and other necessary regulatory standards.

However, we must navigate a recent shift in local regulatory policy. Due to the specific danger classification of this medical device, our Ministry of Health (MOH) has become significantly more restrictive regarding imports originating from G4 countries, including China, India, and Southeast Asia. 

Given these strict new regulations, if the process of obtaining the required standards and certificates proves to be too time-consuming, we would like to propose alternative manufacturing and shipping strategies. While an OEM arrangement is a viable option, we highly recommend pursuing CKD (Completely Knocked Down) or SKD (Semi-Knocked Down) assembly. 

Transitioning to CKD or SKD offers substantial strategic advantages. In our country, local CKD/SKD production benefits heavily from special government facilities, domestic production incentives, and job creation initiatives. Leveraging these programs will allow us to bypass bureaucratic hurdles and resolve standards and licensing obstacles much faster. To assure you of our capability in this area, we have successfully executed CKD orders with major international medical brands, including VIMS from France and Hermann from Germany. 

To demonstrate our commitment to this project and your brand, we are prepared to commit to an initial order of more than 200 devices over an 18-month period. Furthermore, if the trial version and subsequent field tests of the Insufflator meet our clinical and operational needs, we anticipate ordering a significantly higher quantity.

We would love to schedule a brief call next week to discuss your thoughts on an SKD/CKD partnership and how we can move forward profitably. 

Thank you for your time and continued partnership. 

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Company Name]
[Your Contact Information]
